tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground, as rendered behind the page's content (the body gradient, averaged). Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: page-text
tokens.usage: Default body text on `page-bg`: the colour most of the page's text uses that reads on it (17.1:1).

tokens.name: page-surface
tokens.usage: Surface most of the page's running text sits on (cards, panels).

tokens.name: royal-blue
tokens.usage: Royal authority, trust, scientific precision, institutional stability. Used as text on `.page-title`, `.stat-value`, `.section-title`. 8.4:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: academy-gold
tokens.usage: Royal crest, fellowship medals, academic achievement. Used as text on `.header::before`, `.header .royal-motto`, `.nav a:hover, .nav a.active`; border on `.nav a:hover, .nav a.active`. 2.2:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: deep-navy
tokens.usage: Depth of knowledge, scholarly seriousness, intellectual authority.

tokens.name: parchment-cream
tokens.usage: Ancient manuscripts, publication paper, academic tradition.

tokens.name: scholar-black
tokens.usage: Academic robes, formal authority, text clarity. Used as text on `body`, `.stat-description`, `.badge-laureate`. 17.1:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: crown-purple
tokens.usage: Royal regalia, distinction, ceremonial importance. Used as text on `.badge-high-impact`. 6.8:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: emerald-green
tokens.usage: Peer review approved, publication success, grant awarded. Used as text on `.citation-count`, `.badge-peer-reviewed`. 3.6:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.

tokens.name: oxford-red
tokens.usage: Academic importance, citation markers, emphasis.

tokens.name: silver-gray
tokens.usage: Secondary information, supporting data, methodology notes. Used as text on `.page-subtitle`, `.stat-label`, `.publication-authors`. 4.6:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: ivory-white
tokens.usage: Pristine publication, clean data presentation. Used as text on `.header h1`, `.nav a`, `.publication-table th`. 1.0:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: copper-accent
tokens.usage: Historical instruments, laboratory equipment, observation.
